key.name: panel-box
key.description: Determines which section of the GNOME top bar the indicator appears in. Allowed values: 'left', 'center', 'right'.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Order index inside the chosen panel box.

key.name: show-status-dot
key.description: Show or hide the colored status dot (●) in the top bar.

key.name: show-status-text
key.description: Show or hide the status text ([Connected] / [Disconnected] / [Offline]).

key.name: show-mode-badge
key.description: Show or hide the [TUN] / [Proxy] mode badge in the top bar.

key.name: show-speed
key.description: Show or hide download and upload speeds in the top bar.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Preferred terminal emulator command to launch WhoisThat TUI: 'auto', 'alacritty', 'gnome-terminal', 'ptyxis', 'kitty', 'ghostty', 'xterm'.
